appliedUpdates.description: Add gpu-testing-patterns.md documenting DuplicateContext pattern for testing editor actions without GPU, and destroy_emitter() config zeroing behavior

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add test naming convention: tests named test_<method>_* should call the method under test, not just verify post-conditions on raw structs. If GPU context prevents calling the method, name the test to reflect what is actually being tested (e.g., test_emitter_state_default_values instead of test_reset_all_clears_emitter_states).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature implement-reset-particle-system: katla_gfx/src/particles/mod.rs tests named test_reset_all_* construct raw ParticleEmitterPool structs and verify Default trait behavior rather than calling GlobalParticleSystem::reset_all().

rejectedObservations.observation: DrawableComponent does not derive Clone or Copy, requiring manual field-by-field copying
rejectedObservations.reason: too-specific — this is an implementation detail of a single component type, not a pattern workers need to know about

rejectedObservations.observation: GlobalParticleSystem cannot be constructed without a real GPU, making particle emitter handle creation untestable in unit tests
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented — .factory/library/testing-infrastructure.md already covers GPU testing limitations and the pragmatic approach of testing CPU-side logic in isolation

rejectedObservations.observation: GlobalParticleSystem unit tests can only test CPU-side data structures (ParticleEmitterPool, ParticleCounters, EmitterState) in isolation
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented — same constraint covered in testing-infrastructure.md
